learning_objective: The learner can evaluate a model's performance using benchmarks, evaluation metrics, and comparative testing to determine its suitability for a target application.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing that public benchmarks alone can identify the best model for a specific application.
Confusing comparative evaluation (which model is better) with absolute performance (whether a model is good enough).
Assuming benchmark results are always valid despite potential data contamination in model training sets.
